reason: A Cordis plugin that automatically selects configured LLM provider routes, explains routing decisions, performs optional health checks, and conservatively fails over before response output.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中根据环境、端点和模型提示选择已配置的 LLM 路由，并在输出前进行可选健康检查与故障转移。
summaries.en: Selects among configured LLM routes in DeepSeek Harness using environment, endpoint, and model signals, with optional health checks and pre-output failover.

capabilities: Discovers and selects among already registered LLM provider routes
Reads configured environment-variable presence as routing signals without logging credential values
Performs bounded health checks through the official adapter when available
Retries failed requests on alternate routes only before any visible output is emitted
Provides route-selection diagnostics and failover errors
